title: Login with valid credentials
steps: Enter a valid registered username in the username field
expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the home/dashboard page; no error message is shown.

title: Login with valid username and incorrect password
expected: Login is rejected and an 'Invalid username or password' error is displayed; user remains on the login page.

title: Login with unregistered username and any password
steps: Enter a username that does not exist in the system
expected: Login is rejected and the generic 'Invalid username or password' error is displayed (no details revealing whether the account exists).

title: Login with locked-out account using correct credentials
steps: Ensure the test account is in locked-out state
Enter the locked account's valid username and correct password
expected: Login is blocked and a 'Your account is locked. Contact support' (or equivalent) error is displayed; user is not authenticated.

title: Login with both fields empty
expected: Login is not submitted; validation messages for both required fields are displayed and the user remains on the login page.

title: Login with password field empty only
expected: Login is not submitted; a 'Password is required' validation message is displayed and no authentication occurs.

title: Login with username field empty only
expected: Login is not submitted; a 'Username is required' validation message is displayed and no authentication occurs.

title: Account locks out after repeated failed login attempts
steps: Enter a valid username and an incorrect password
Click the Login button repeatedly up to and beyond the configured threshold (e.g., 5 attempts)
Attempt login once more with the correct password
expected: After the threshold is reached the account is locked; further attempts, including correct credentials, are rejected with a lock-out error message.
